subject: Onboarding for air-gapped deployment — offline image validation & operator handoff
messages:
From: J. Hargreaves <j.hargreaves@acmeindustrial.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com
Cc: ops@acmeindustrial.com
Date: 2026-12-20 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Air-gapped onboarding: image transfer, signature verification, and operator acceptance

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Were preparing our isolated site for the Redwood private deployment and need to align on the offline image delivery, signing strategy, and the operator acceptance steps. A few items we want to confirm before we schedule the courier:

- Manifest format you expect (hashes, versioning)
- Who performs the signing ceremony and how we verify signatures without internet
- Operator checklist for verification and smoke validation once image is loaded
- Expiry window for the signed artifacts and a rollback trigger plan

Can someone from your team send the exact acceptance checklist and a sample signed manifest so our security team can pre-approve? Wed like the transfer to happen the week of Jan 4.

Best,
James Hargreaves
Head of Infrastructure, Acme Industrial

--
From: olga.petrov@redwood.com
To: J. Hargreaves <j.hargreaves@acmeindustrial.com>
Cc: alex.martinez@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-21 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Air-gapped onboarding: image transfer, signature verification, and operator acceptance

Thanks James — great to get this scheduled. Attaching a concise acceptance checklist and a sample signed manifest (see attachments). High-level answers below, and Alex & Priyom are looped for technical details and the signing ceremony flow.

1) Manifest format- We provide a simple JSON manifest with fields: image_name, image_tag, sha256 (artifact), signing_key_id, signature (base64), created_at, expires_at, and an ops_notes blob. See attached redwood-offline-manifest-v1.2.json.

2) Signing ceremony- For air-gapped customers we support two models:
  - Customer-held key: you provide a public key; Redwood signs a build in a hermetic environment and returns the signature blob. Signatures are created during an audited build step and the signature uses an offline RSA-4096 key by default.
  - Joint ceremony: Redwood performs build+signing in our secure environment; we provide a signed manifest and a PKI chain that you can validate with a short fingerprint. Priyom can schedule a key exchange/out-of-band verification.

3) Operator checklist (summary)
  - Verify manifest signature: fetch manifest, check signing_key_id and compute local sha256 of artifact, verify signature using provided public key.
  - Confirm created_at and that now < expires_at.
  - Load image into isolated registry or disk, run checksum post-copy, and perform smoke tests (auth, model load, small prompt run).
  - Capture logs and a short attestation file (operator name, time, checksum).

4) Rollback and expiry- Signed artifacts will include an expires_at. If operator sees a mismatch or artifact expired, follow rollback: do not activate, contact Redwood support (we keep prior signed images for 7 days as a contingency).

Attachments: redwood-offline-manifest-v1.2.json (sample), operator-checklist-acme.pdf (template). Also included: signed-image-20261220.tar.sig (example signature blob).

Next steps: Alex will add a small verification script we recommend you run on-operator workstation, and Priyom will propose 2 dates for the key-exchange/checksum verification call.

Cheers,
Olga Petrov
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com

--
From: alex.martinez@redwood.com
To: J. Hargreaves <j.hargreaves@acmeindustrial.com>, olga.petrov@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-22 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Air-gapped onboarding: image transfer, signature verification, and operator acceptance

James — quick technical note and a small utility attached:

- Weve put together a lightweight verification script (bash + openssl) that:
  1) computes sha256 of provided tarball,
  2) validates base64 signature against the public key (we ship the public key in the manifest bundle),
  3) writes an attestation.json with operator id, checksum, and timestamp.

- For the transfer medium: we recommend USB-dataset encrypted with a one-time password and a tamper-evident courier seal. The courier can be your regular logistics partner (Tony at Edge Freight is copied).

- If you want redundancy: include a small bootable USB with a minimal checker image (we can provide) so your operator can run checks without relying on local toolchains.

Ill attach the script in the Drive link milestone; if you want it embedded in the bundle we can include it as verified content and sign the utility as well.

—Alex Martinez
Infra & Deployment Engineer, Redwood Inference

--
From: priyom.das@redwood.com
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com, J. Hargreaves <j.hargreaves@acmeindustrial.com>, alex.martinez@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-23 14:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Air-gapped onboarding: image transfer, signature verification, and operator acceptance

Hi all — scheduling note for the signing/key-exchange and handoff:

- Proposed slots (all PST): Jan 5 09:00-09:30, Jan 6 14:00-14:30. Please confirm a preferred slot. The call will include a short manual key fingerprint verification step and a readout of the manifest fields.
- Ill prepare a one-page runbook describing the quorum for approval (which operator fields to record) and an emergency contact tree if checks fail.

Operational constraints to call out now:
- If the signed images expires_at is within 48 hours of receipt, operator should NOT activate; treat as expired.
- If checksum mismatch occurs after copy, do not boot; capture a screen/video of the checksum attempt and raise a support ticket with priority-high.

Olga — can you confirm well provide the prior-signed image for the 7-day contingency and the verification script will be included in the signed bundle?

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Release Engineering, Redwood Inference

--

- For the contingency image retention: 7 days is fine, but wed like a written SLA to include notification if any signed-image is revoked.

We will run through the operator checklist on a staging island next week and provide feedback. Tony will coordinate the courier and secure packing.

Thanks,
James
